name: Status request
trigger: email-status or teams-ask intent, or an email asking where something stands

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: The hourly sweep spots the status question in mail or Teams; master then asks the client agent to read the status.

steps.name: Status read
steps.means: The client agent reads where the work stands and hands back what it found.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 11 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Draft reply
steps.means: The client agent writes the reply from that read; nothing is sent.

spec.goal: Draft the reply to the client email this case answers ({root_title}), from the finished step's result.
spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} with fields ["verdict", "evidence", "pointers", "summary"]; the case's intent is {intent}.
constraints: Nothing sends: write the body to a file and return the draft_reply envelope.
The body ends with 'Thanks!' and no name; Ben's Outlook signature carries it.
Promise nothing no task covers; if the answer needs more work, put it in follow_ups instead.

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the draft against the client-email checklist (when that gate is on).
steps.gate: client-email checklist, when the gate is on

steps.name: Outlook draft
steps.means: Master types the approved draft into Ben's Outlook Drafts folder.
steps.gate: minder lists finished drafts; master types it into Drafts

steps.name: Send
steps.means: Ben reads the draft in Outlook and sends it; that closes the case.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 13 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)
